optimistic--adj.ex: He stays optimistic about the harvest.

fireplace--noun.def: The open space in a wall where a fire is lit.
fireplace--noun.ex: A log burned in the fireplace.

mixture--noun.def: Two or more things combined together.
mixture--noun.ex: Pour the mixture into a tin.

crocodile--noun.def: A large reptile with strong jaws that lives in rivers.
crocodile--noun.ex: A crocodile lay on the bank.

mist--noun.def: A thin cloud close to the ground.

bikini--noun.def: A two-piece swimming costume for women.
bikini--noun.ex: She packed a bikini and a towel.

arch--noun.def: A curved structure over a door or a bridge.
arch--noun.ex: The stone arch is very old.

percentage--noun.def: An amount expressed as a part of a hundred.

bravery--noun.def: Courage shown in a dangerous situation.
bravery--noun.ex: He received a medal for bravery.

morality--noun.def: Ideas about what behaviour is right and wrong.

leopard--noun.def: A large wild cat with dark spots.
leopard--noun.ex: A leopard rested in the tree.

vaccine--noun.def: A substance given to protect against a disease.
vaccine--noun.ex: The vaccine is free for children.

motivated--adj.def: Keen to work hard towards a goal.

burglary--noun.def: The crime of entering a building to steal.
burglary--noun.ex: There were two burglaries last week.

resolution--noun.def: A firm decision, or the sharpness of a screen image.

wink--noun.def: A quick closing of one eye as a signal.

assessment--noun.def: A judgement about how good or how serious something is.

getaway--noun.def: An escape after a crime, or a short holiday.

leash--noun.def: A cord used to hold and control a dog.
leash--noun.ex: Keep the dog on a leash.

cocoa--noun.def: A brown powder from cocoa beans used to make chocolate.
cocoa--noun.ex: Add cocoa to the warm milk.

perception--noun.def: The way you notice or understand something.

dense--adj.ex: A dense forest covers the hill.

nod--verb.def: To move your head down and up to mean yes.

nervously--adv.def: In a worried and uneasy way.

veteran--noun.def: A former soldier, or a very experienced person.

unaware--adj.def: Not knowing that something exists or is happening.
unaware--adj.ex: She was unaware of the change.

assemble--verb.def: To put parts together, or to gather in a group.
assemble--verb.ex: The shelves are easy to assemble.

generosity--noun.def: The quality of giving freely to others.

evidently--adv.def: Clearly, judging by what can be seen.

evacuation--noun.def: The act of moving people away from danger.

closure--noun.def: The permanent shutting of a business or a road.
closure--noun.exTr: Kapanma kırk iş kaybına yol açtı.

excessive--adj.def: Much more than is reasonable or necessary.

rattle--noun.def: A quick series of short knocking sounds.
rattle--noun.ex: A rattle came from the engine.

pneumonia--noun.def: A serious illness affecting the lungs.
pneumonia--noun.ex: He was in hospital with pneumonia.

royalty--noun.def: Members of a royal family, or money paid to a writer.

ache--verb.def: To feel a continuous dull pain.
ache--verb.ex: My legs ache after the climb.

sympathetic--adj.def: Showing that you understand someone's trouble.

relay--noun.def: A race in which team members take turns.

particle--noun.def: An extremely small piece of matter.

electronics--noun.def: The science of electronic devices, or the devices themselves.

daytime--noun.def: The hours between sunrise and sunset.
daytime--noun.ex: The shop is busy in the daytime.

dowry--noun.def: Money or goods a bride brings to a marriage.
dowry--noun.ex: The custom of a dowry is old.

faculty--noun.def: A department of a university, or a natural ability.
faculty--noun.ex: She teaches in the law faculty.

ounce--noun.def: A small unit of weight, about twenty-eight grams.

console--verb.def: To comfort someone who is sad.

caravan--noun.def: A vehicle you live in while travelling, or a group crossing a desert.

defy--verb.def: To refuse to obey a person or a rule.
defy--verb.ex: He defied the ban and spoke.

queue--verb.def: To stand in a line and wait your turn.

willingly--adv.def: Without being forced or asked twice.
willingly--adv.ex: She willingly gave up her seat.

cheeky--adj.def: Slightly rude in an amusing way.

cruelty--noun.def: Behaviour that causes pain to others on purpose.
cruelty--noun.ex: The law punishes cruelty to animals.

quarantine--noun.def: A period of being kept apart to stop a disease spreading.

squash--noun.def: A vegetable of the pumpkin family, or an indoor racket game.
squash--noun.ex: He plays squash twice a week.

squash--verb.def: To press something so it becomes flat.

tuition--noun.def: Teaching, especially in small groups, or the fee for it.
tuition--noun.exTr: Öğrenim ücreti bu yıl yine arttı.

tame--adj.def: Not wild, and used to being with people.

criticism--noun.def: Remarks saying what is wrong with something.

tread--verb.def: To put your foot down on something.
tread--verb.ex: Do not tread on the seedlings.

exploit--verb.def: To use someone unfairly, or to make good use of something.

seminar--noun.def: A meeting for teaching and discussion in a small group.

evaluation--noun.def: A careful judgement of value or quality.

cube--noun.def: A solid shape with six equal square sides.

alternate--verb.def: To do two things one after the other, again and again.

diversion--noun.def: A different route around a closed road, or something that distracts.

effectively--adv.def: In a way that works well, or in practice.

dedication--noun.def: Great effort given to a cause, or words offering a work to someone.

dye--noun.def: A substance used to change the colour of cloth or hair.

prospect--noun.def: The possibility that something will happen.
prospect--noun.ex: There is little prospect of rain.

thigh--noun.def: The upper part of the leg above the knee.

accusation--noun.def: A statement that someone has done something wrong.
